=== Ukrainian and Indonesian labels ===

You are right that the pairs framing was superseded. Your four-step path is now written down in the repo as [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/docs/description_label_policy.md docs/description_label_policy.md], quoted verbatim, and <code>CLAUDE.md</code> points at it — it had been living only in a chat message and one script docstring, which is why the answer here was still describing the old mechanism.

Where the two meet: the pairs pipeline resolves an orphan description by '''supplying the missing label''', which is what your step 1 is protecting. Removal is only for the residue where no label can be generated. That is why the blanket 9,615-line removals file was wrong and got deleted — 3,511 of its items were also queued for a description by the other pipeline.

Measured today, descriptions on items with no label in that language ([https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/orphan_descriptions_audit.json orphan_descriptions_audit.json], 10,250 total): '''id 5,024''', '''uk 4,591''', nl 168, everything else small.

: '''✓ Yes, it is staged for removal, and it is safe.''' <code>-Q135041321|P31|Q135009132</code> sits in [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/daily_operations.txt daily_operations.txt] and in <code>migrate_ritsuryo_funding_remove.txt</code>. It is the '''remove half''' of an add-first/remove-later migration that moved these register classifications off ''instance of'' and onto '''shrine ranking''' with a ''determination method'' qualifier. The add half already ran — its file is empty because it is drained.
: [[d:Q135041321|Q135041321]] already carries the migrated form: '''shrine ranking → 月次新嘗''' qualified ''determination method → Q135009120''. So dropping the ''instance of'' loses nothing. The 2026-07-10 audit checked all 4,802 pairs item-by-item and found zero that would destroy an unmigrated fact.
: '''On "is it still running or is it just over"''' — the classification is a 927 ''Engishiki'' register annotation, not a live practice; the imperial 幣帛 distribution it records lapsed centuries ago. But that is not why it is being removed. It is being removed because it was recorded on the wrong property, and the historical fact is kept on the right one.

It carries ''shrine ranking → 月次新嘗'' '''twice''' and ''shrine ranking → [[d:Q135160338|Q135160338]]'' '''twice''', each pair identical down to the qualifier. Not staged for anything. Queued as its own item — the question is whether the duplication is item-local or systemic across the migration's ~4,800 items, and that is a measurement, not a guess.
